returned_verdict.verdict: PASS. All four prior findings and the adjacent params-rebinding fix are resolved in the shown diff. Two low-severity test-strength notes and one info note, nothing blocking, no threshold or digest change.
resolved: F1 gap_restart: gap now requires an existing segment. _segment is non-None only when the previous step was tracking and usable, so _time is set and the gap is measured from the last segment frame. Only the reason string changes versus the old code; candidate/event timing is unchanged. Covered by the sparse-initialization test and the pilot histogram test.

F2 min_continuity: retention with rationale is sound. _validate accepts external_seed only from unseeded, forbids unseeded after tracking and makes lost terminal, so a stream has at most one seed and it is always the first observation of its segment: continuity >= observations-1. __post_init__ enforces min_continuity < min_observations, so the gate is implied for every constructible params object. The new test checks the identity for a seed segment (3 of 4) and a motion-restarted segment (4 of 4).
F3 long timestamps: hold, gap and diameter boundary tests now run at offsets 0.0 and 3600.4 as claimed (strength caveat in findings).

F4 OverflowError: _number returns False when math.isfinite raises on an oversized int, so frame_seconds, point_px entries and the three float params reject 10**400 with ValueError; atomic-rejection and params-invalid lists were extended.
Params rebinding: params is a read-only property over _params; assignment raises AttributeError and _digest stays tied to the constructed object. The regression test asserts both.
check_project.py adds exactly four paths (two modules, two tests). StationaryParams defaults are unchanged, so the preregistered digest is unchanged.

findings.title: Offset 3600.4 tests cannot detect rounding regressions
findings.detail: In the binade [2048,4096) the ulp is 2^-41 and fl(0.3)/ulp has fractional part ~0.5999, so fl(a+0.3)-a rounds up to 0.3+1.8e-13 for every offset there; the hold test passes even if the 1e-9 tolerance is deleted. fl(0.45)-fl(0.2) is exactly 0.25, so a+0.45 and a+0.2 always round identically and the gap test yields exactly 0.25 at any offset. Add an offset in a round-down binade (1800.4 or 10000.4) for hold, and a gap pair whose difference is not exactly representable (0.1 to 0.35) for gap.

findings.title: Gap comparison has no tolerance, unlike hold (pre-existing, inside F3 scope)
findings.detail: t - self._time > max_gap_seconds uses raw subtraction while the hold check applies +1e-9 for the same stated reason. At large absolute times a nominal 0.25 s gap can round to 0.25 plus one ulp and spuriously reset the segment. Author's call whether to mirror the tolerance; preregistered values would be unchanged.

findings.title: Continuity test proves accounting, not invariance
findings.detail: Parametrizing min_continuity over 1..min_observations-1 and asserting identical selection outputs (ignoring params_sha256) would show the gate never binds.
